name: VRM_CONTRACT_ALLOC_GT
description: This table temporarily contains contract allocation processing-related information.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Discount method used in allocation.

columns.name: PARENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: The batch to be processed.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Revenue price line.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: POB_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion rate date used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation.

columns.name: CONTRACT_AMT
columns.description: Total contract transaction price in the ledger currency

columns.name: POL_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Derived FMV amount for a performance obligation line.

columns.name: POB_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Derived FMV amount for a performance obligation.

columns.name: ALLOC_CONTRACT_AMT
columns.description: Contract amount eligible for allocation.

columns.name: EXEMPT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this performance obligation is exempt from allocation.

columns.name: POL_TOTAL_FMV_AMT
columns.description: Sum of fair market values of lines under a unique performance obligation.

columns.name: POL_TOTAL_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Sum of line net consideration amounts under a unique performance obligation.

columns.name: POB_LINES_WITHOUT_FMV_COUNT
columns.description: The count of lines without an FMV under a unique performance obligation.

columns.name: POL_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Performance obligation line net consideration amount.

columns.name: POB_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Performance obligation net consideration amount.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Contract currency code.

columns.name: POB_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Performance obligation currency code.

columns.name: REMOVED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance obligation line is removed from the performance obligation.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_STATUS
columns.description: Allocation status of the customer contract. Values are derived from lookup type ORA_VRM_CONTRACT_ALLOCN_STATUS.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: A fair market value of an item, item group, or memo line in entered currency.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from the VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_CODE
columns.description: The fair market value tolerance range level used to calculate the discount amount.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_HIGH
columns.description: High price percentage of the FMV tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_LOW
columns.description: Low price percentage of the FMV tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_REVIEW_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of VSOE value review. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REVIEW_STATUS.

columns.name: LINE_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: Net consideration amount of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contract review should be queued for manual review. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of the performance obligaton line.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost of sale after the document is revised.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue price amount in the entered currency.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price used to validate the revenue price value of a line.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price represented by the unit selling price, discount percent, or any other representation type.

columns.name: PRICE_EFF_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: VSOE price effectivity period unique identifier.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Item type unique identifier. Value populated in this column is related to the primary key of the entity provided in ITEM_TYPE.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. The valid values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure of inventory item or memo line on source document line.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Pricing dimension combination identifier.

columns.name: FMV_IN_USE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the FMV line has been used in compliance process. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: IS_TEMPLATE_BASED_OBLIG_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: LINE_STATUS
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: POL_IMMATERIAL_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Promised detail line level immaterial details unique identifier.

columns.name: PO_IMMATERIAL_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation level immaterial details unique identifier.

columns.name: LATEST_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_CODE
columns.description: Latest immaterial change type processed on this customer contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_IMMATERIAL_CHANGE_TYPE.

columns.name: SERVICE_DURATION
columns.description: Duration of the service item in terms of the service unit of measure.

columns.name: SSP_LOW
columns.description: The low point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_MID
columns.description: The mid point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_HIGH
columns.description: The high point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_SALES_POINT
columns.description: The price determined and published by the business as published sales point of an item or service.

columns.name: BELOW_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is below the SSP Low Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: IN_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is between the SSP Low and SSP High Points. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: ABOVE_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is above the SSP High Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: SSP_RANGE_TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: The tolerance percentage in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business. The SSP Low Point and SSP High Point are calculated by the application when the SSP tolerance percentage and SSP midpoint are provided for an item or service.

columns.name: ABS_SSP_PO
columns.description: The absolute value of unit standalone selling Price for an item or service.

columns.name: PO_SSP_RANGE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule that is applied to the performance obligation template in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_RULE.

columns.name: PO_SSP_RULE_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: The result of the rule that is applied to the performance obligation template in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: ABS_SSP_POL
columns.description: The absolute value of the unit standalone selling price for an item or service.

columns.name: POL_SSP_RANGE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule that is applied to the promised detail in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_RULE.

columns.name: POL_SSP_RULE_RESULT_CODE
columns.description: The result of the rule that is applied to the promised detail in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: REFERENCE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency used as the reference currency for converting entered currency amounts to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Rate type used to convert entered currency amounts to reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE_DATE
columns.description: Date used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the reference currency.

columns.name: REFERENCE_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Rate used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the reference currency.

columns.name: OBLIGATION_CURRENCY_UNIT_SSP
columns.description: The unit standalone selling price in obligation currency.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.
